item.title: 11-term House rep who mocked a kid’s letter about EVs has lost her seat (Upd.)
item.description: An 83 year old Congressional representative who sent an embarrassing letter to a well-meaning 10 year old constituent on the topic of electric cars and climate change, where she seems to brag about saddling his generation with debt through a recent climate rollback she voted for, has lost her seat.
